name: eth_h48qual_alone_candidacy_20260808
created: 2026-08-08, written BEFORE any VAL or tail number for this comparison was computed
question: Should ETH's live config become h48qual ALONE instead of the h48qual>zig075 greedy router?

2026-08-01_gated_oos_2026H1.verdict_then: h48qual-only lost decisively; the memory closed the question with 'do not re-propose without new evidence'

2026-08-08_no_gate_oos_2026H1.what_is_new: the earlier test was duration-GATED. ETH live runs FINAL_GOVERNOR_OMEGA4_6_1_ETH_DURATION_GATE_OFF=True, so the NO-GATE basis is the live-relevant one, and on that basis h48qual-only ties on Calmar with a materially better drawdown and is the only arm positive in both quarters. That is the new evidence justifying one more look.

window_honesty.oos_2026-01-01..06-30: CONTAMINATED -- used by both prior comparisons. Descriptive only; cannot decide anything.
window_honesty.val_2025-10-01..12-31: never used for THIS comparison, but the components' bundles/sidecars/scale-map were SELECTED on it. Therefore usable only as a FALSIFICATION test: a win here is weak evidence, a loss here is strong evidence against.
window_honesty.tail_2026-07-01..07-12: genuinely untouched by both prior comparisons (both stopped at 06-30), but only ~12 days of predictions -- expect 1-3 trades. Reported, never decisive.
window_honesty.forward_live_shadow: the only clean referee that can justify a live swap, and it does not exist yet.

metric_basis.primary: NO-GATE (matches the live wiring, gate is off)
metric_basis.secondary: duration-gated, reported for comparability with the 2026-08-01 test

G1_falsification_on_VAL.rule: h48qual_only Calmar >= 0.70 x router Calmar AND h48qual_only MDD >= router MDD - 3.0pp, on the NO-GATE basis
G1_falsification_on_VAL.rationale: VAL is where h48qual's own components were fit. If it cannot stay within striking distance of the router there, the OOS result was a window artifact and the line closes.
G1_falsification_on_VAL.on_fail: CLOSE the line. Do not re-propose h48qual-alone for ETH without a genuinely new model or new data.

G2_tail_report_only.rule: no gate -- the 2026-07-01..07-12 numbers are reported for completeness and explicitly cannot pass or fail the candidate
G2_tail_report_only.rationale: 1-3 trades cannot decide anything; recording it prevents it from being quietly used later as if it could

G3_outcome_ceiling.rule: the BEST outcome available from this contract is 'promote to a parallel ETH SHADOW', never a live swap
G3_outcome_ceiling.rationale: no window in this dataset can justify replacing a live config for this question; only a forward live record can. This ceiling is fixed now so a good VAL number cannot be talked into a swap later.

if_G1_passes: stand up h48qual-alone as a second ETH shadow process alongside the live router (same pattern as the BTC multislot+overlay shadow), and let the live records decide. Minimum 3 months of shadow before any swap discussion.
if_G1_fails: close the line and record it; the 2026-08-01 conclusion stands.

fresh_forward.method: three arms through the same imported greedy_replay; equity compounds inside each replay so component removal is a true counterfactual
